threshold.text: Beneath the old city, you find a sealed archive with a blue door, a narrow stairwell, and a plaque covered in dust. What do you do?

choices.label: Read the plaque
choices.response: The plaque warns that every door in the archive opens only once. A faint line beneath it reads: 'The way forward remembers your steps.'

gallery.text: The blue door opens into a gallery of glass cases. A sealed ledger rests beneath a silver lamp.

stairwell.text: The stairs wind upward to a landing. You hear pages turning somewhere below and see a hatch leading toward the rooftops.

seal_room.text: The ledger lies open on a stone desk. Its final page has your name written in fresh ink.

roof.text: You emerge onto the rooftops beneath a field of bright stars. A lighthouse flashes beyond the river.

choices.label: Follow the rooftops out of town

outside.text: You leave the archive behind. By morning, the blue door has vanished from beneath the city.

ledger_ending.text: The ledger closes by itself. The ink fades, and every page turns blank except the last: 'You chose to remember.'

lighthouse_ending.text: A light flashes back from the lighthouse. Somewhere below, the archive door clicks shut for the final time.
